8.heading: Therefore:
refs: From this it appears that Job was considered as a priest, not only to his own family, but also to others. For his children he offered burnt offerings - Job 1:5 and now he is to make the same kind of offerings, accompanied with intercession, in behalf of his three friends. This is a full proof of the innocence and integrity of Job.
